body:
GMEOW trimmed Unicode whitespace before native datatype parsing, so an invalid source such as an NBSP-wrapped integer could acquire a value and satisfy a datatype range. Pass original XSD lexical forms to PurRDF and delete the trimming branch and its String/AnyURI exceptions. Route OWL rational literals directly to the native fraction parser, deleting the local trim and decimal retry. Preserve real value-space membership without inventing lexical forms for owl:real. Principles 4, 7 and 17: the native implementation owns datatype admission.

Both manifests and lockfiles select merged native revision 0994332d93bc89747f95e5a942715faf36129648. Its shared String/AnyURI validator selects XML 1.1 characters, preserves valid controls and rejects NUL/U+FFFE/U+FFFF before allocation. That correction passed the complete native XSD suite, strict clippy, actual WASM text tests and full SHACL 1.2 conformance, including the previously failing singleLine case. Both tiny GMEOW attestations were regenerated through the existing verified producer for this final pin.

All 82 distinct local synthetic cases passed: 62 consumer/identity/witness/slicetest cases, 19 authored-program datatype cases and one selector-admission case. Strict affected all-target clippy and every normal commit/push hook passed. Five identity/read-only-witness controls passed again after adding test descriptions. The complete 41-case slicetest selection ran with all fixture and bundle selector variables unset; its soleness and source-cache repair was already landed and is now freshly qualified.

CodeRabbit reviewed the production correction through bbe250ab8 with no actionable comments and minimal reported risk. Its rational finding is fixed; test descriptions also address its documentation-coverage finding. The final documentation-only child changes no production code or attestation. Full corpus/browser hosted qualification remains pending under the explicit instruction to merge and address subsequent CI findings. No corpus factory, dependency, compatibility path or gate weakening is introduced.

Primary implementation scope is [the datatype-ownership requirement in issue 1803](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/issues/1803): PurRDF owns XSD/OWL value spaces, with exactly one mechanism owner and deletion of the inferior copy. This PR advances that requirement; the broader class-model/chase ownership and complete corpus qualification remain open.

Issue #1764 was already implemented before this PR. The fresh qualification above establishes its acceptance; its completion will be recorded on that issue after integration rather than attributing its earlier implementation to this PR. The full logic issue/PR objective is unchanged.
title: fix(logic): preserve native datatype lexical admission

body:
Delegate anyURI semantics to PurRDF's native datatype engine and delete the ad-hoc GMEOW membership, equality, normalization, primitive recognition and capacity paths. Native literal lengths now use the same native facet measure as range analysis. Preserve the original lexical before anyURI parsing, including Unicode whitespace outside the XML collapse set; distinct interpreted URI values now produce a proved inequality instead of an unknown result.

Bind the immutable upstream source pin into the portable reasoning identity alongside its calculus and canonical rule hashes. Datatype implementation changes can leave rule syntax unchanged, so rule hashes alone cannot identify the delegated semantics. Source selection reads the declared manifest structurally and refuses a missing or mutable pin; execution limits remain in operation receipts. Refresh the two tiny, verified reasoner attestations and replace references to the retired conjecture-only refresh target.

Principles 4 and 17: one mechanism owner, one native implementation, no compatibility fallback. Advances #1803; the larger reasoning ownership migration remains open. PurRDF implementation: Blackcat-Informatics/purrdf#573. Both manifests and lockfiles select the preserved implementation head; no unrelated dependency update is included.

Validation: all 19 final synthetic tests passed against the corrected native pin, covering production datatype consumers, immutable source binding, portable identity controls and both witness readers. Affected-package all-target clippy and both normal commit hooks passed. Both tiny attestations were regenerated and verified against the corrected pin. Four Node parity cases passed on the unchanged GMEOW Rust implementation before the final upstream pin update; the corrected native engine separately passed its complete XSD suite, 17 datatype consumer tests, warnings-as-errors clippy and three actual WASM cases. Full final-pin browser/corpus CI remains pending under the existing instruction to merge and track subsequent CI findings; no final-head browser pass is claimed. No local full corpus producer or machine probes ran.
title: refactor(logic): delegate anyURI semantics to PurRDF

body:
Advances #1803, #1761 and #1762 (Principles 4, 7 and 17).

Recorded world selection now uses the complete production object EDB and the single native graph projection, preserving default, IRI and scoped blank graph identities across base, reifier and annotation slots. The superseded source shortcut and named-only projection API are removed. Production and fuzz locks select the reviewed native implementation.

Source and recorded-consumer errors retain ontology failure classes and original causes. Prover evidence and CLI reports preserve those classes through serialization. All six browser packages share the pinned build recipe. Browser reasoning uses the required host monotonic clock, and its semantic seal folds PurRDF canonical rule hashes rather than target-dependent execution contracts. Actual execution limits and receipts remain unchanged.

The conjecture-only witness refresher is replaced by one verified native producer for both reasoning attestations, excluded from test execution. Its shared closure computation remains read-only in tests; it checks the expected seven-fact closure, both conjecture lifecycles and determinism before publishing. No compatibility alias or unused restore prototype remains.

Validation: the integrated native producer passed, and the actual optimized WebAssembly package passed all four Node checks, including exact closure and conjecture equality. The unchanged query package passed seven Node controls. Prior focused source-census, diagnostic-binding, literal-identity and recorded-world observations remain in the selected Stage evidence. The final affected native selection passed 41 tests, including the target-contract regression, native parity witnesses, typed source failures, report projections and numeric execution.

Hosted run 39005456875 passed producer-build, rust-prebuild, lint and helpers, but generation/prefix jobs were killed or canceled and downstream acceptance did not run. This observed failure is tracked on #1757; no resource cause is inferred. Fresh CI is required for the pushed head. The historical language packet was correctly refused because its source identity differs from the current codebook pin; no source identity or fixture admission was weakened.

The complete class-engine delegation and full-canon logic goal remain active; this PR does not close #1803. Authoritative plan and evidence: `.stage/split-gmeow-purrdf-responsibilities/plan.md` and `validation.md`.
title: fix(logic): preserve native evidence and portable reasoning identities

body:
Reusable probabilistic configuration declarations currently fail source compilation unless an arbitrary probability model is also present in the source graph. That prevents the canonical preset from reaching classical proof admission even though this task only catalogues configurations. Separate declaration parsing from the existing query-selected probabilistic execution boundary, removing the graph-wide model scan and its unused helper. Static facet/compatibility failures remain errors; runtime inference still refuses unmodelled probabilistic facts.

Account for the exact facet-type support of successfully admitted declarations before admitting source statements, using the existing native definition-support index. Preserve unrelated domain typings/properties of the same facet resource. Empty configuration catalogues cannot authorize a proof. Update two modal source controls to assert the replacement context/relation/argument coordinates. Update the canonical model-requirement description, French/Chinese translations and governing contract documentation to the query-execution boundary. Principles 4, 7, 12, 17, 18 and 19.

All 287 source/FOF/native probabilistic tests passed in 0.252s. Strict producer-independent workspace/all-target Clippy passed with warnings denied, as did full source lint and helper hygiene. Normal signed commit hooks passed. The final canonical definition and both translation keys agree; no corpus materialization is claimed. Native runtime controls cover refusal with an unselected model present in the world and the expected 0.5 marginal after explicit model selection. No test produces corpus. No local optimized producer, fingerprint or host probe ran.

Advances #1770 and #1768. Full-canon admission, prepared native canon embedding, installed blinded proofs, exact production measurements and full hosted qualification remain open. This increment does not close those issues. Current independent review remains pending.
title: fix(logic): separate configuration declarations from probabilistic execution
